Entry Outsiders in the Crownlands How the king treats outsiders often tells more about its character than official etiquette. The constant flow of outsiders makes the royal territory both open and suspicious; accents, flags, and money bags may all become reasons for scrutiny; trade routes, marriage alliances, and wars will constantly force this kind of judgment. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
